_doc: Pages published to https://austegard.com/experiments/ by .github/workflows/pages.yml. Opt-in: an experiment's HTML is served only when listed here. `path` is a file or a directory (a directory ships its web files: html, js, css, json, images, fonts, wasm, bin). `url` instead links a page hosted elsewhere. Built by _lib/pages_site.py, which fails on a missing path.

pages.title: Pulse From Video
pages.blurb: Eulerian video magnification on the GPU: the camera's colour changes at heart-rate frequencies, amplified 60 times so the flush of blood in your face shows, with a heart-rate estimate and how much auto-exposure is faking it. A curiosity, not a medical device

pages.title: Camera Resonator
pages.blurb: Move in front of the camera to strike a virtual steel plate or a row of bells where the motion is; thousands of modes summed on the GPU per 10 ms block, with dropouts and latency on screen

pages.title: Paper Drum
pages.blurb: Draw a drum on paper and tap it: the camera finds your fingertip, the microphone hears the tap, and the GPU rings a drum skin with the shape you drew

pages.title: Room Drum
pages.blurb: Edges in the camera image become the walls of a drum skin that the GPU steps once per audio sample; tap or move inside a shape to hear how a drum of that outline rings

pages.title: Like Poll
pages.blurb: Bluesky poll builder: sign in, type a question and options, and it posts a thread people vote on with likes; the counter drops anyone who liked more than one option

pages.title: Lantern Eel
pages.blurb: Snake in the deep sea, steered by tilt: the light fades with depth until only the eel's lure shows the way; lanternfish flee, jellyfish rise, pearls let you phase. Installable PWA

pages.title: Scoop
pages.blurb: Minesweeper with dog poop: sweep the long grass, bag the heaps, and step in one to set off the whole lawn. A WebGPU reskin of Sounding. Installable PWA

pages.title: Sounding
pages.blurb: Minesweeper drawn by one WebGPU fragment shader: sonar pings, rippling flood openings, glowing beacons, and a chain detonation with a shockwave and GPU particles. Installable PWA

pages.title: Plumb
pages.blurb: Falling blocks for the phone: tilt to steer, tip to drop faster, jab to hard-drop, shake to hold; SVG well over a WebGPU dust field that pools under real gravity. Installable PWA

pages.title: Raking Light
pages.blurb: Relights flat SVG on the GPU: paint order becomes a heightfield, compute passes add bevels and ambient occlusion, and Kelvin lights cast soft ray-marched shadows

pages.title: Refractometer
pages.blurb: Sweeps WebGPU kernel configurations on your GPU, checks each against a JS reference, and saves the fastest per adapter with the performance cliffs around it

pages.title: Two Prisms
pages.blurb: Five-band spectral audio processor in one WGSL dispatch: FFT, per-band compressor, gate, freeze and mute, inverse FFT, with a live waterfall and the GPU round trip measured against the block length

pages.title: Bit-Plane Dispersion Scan
pages.blurb: Exact int8 top-K search in WebGPU that reads the corpus one bit plane at a time and prunes candidates with provable bounds; compares results, survivor counts and bytes read against brute force

pages.title: Self-painting SVG
pages.blurb: Any picture becomes one SVG that sketches itself in charcoal, paints itself in and falls apart; built in the page, no JavaScript in the output

pages.title: Starry Night, painting itself
pages.blurb: A traced Starry Night sketched, painted, taken to night and dawn, then dismantled on a 48 s loop: one SVG, CSS keyframes from a small timeline compiler, no JavaScript

pages.title: Live camera tagger
pages.blurb: Point your phone camera at something: MobileCLIP-S0 on WebGPU tags each frame against 4,585 tags embedded ahead of time, with no text model in the page

pages.title: Image to SVG in the browser
pages.blurb: image-to-svg ported to the page: k-means in WGSL (JavaScript fallback), pixel-edge tracing and image-to-svg 1.9.0's compact output, all client-side

pages.title: Warhol palette cycle
pages.blurb: One traced cat drawn four times, cycling four palettes with @property colors and offset keyframes; 72 KB, no JavaScript

pages.title: Navier–Stokes term by term
pages.blurb: Interactive WebGPU explainer: the four terms, Reynolds number, vortex stretching, the Beale–Kato–Majda criterion and the 2026 forced blowup results

pages.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 search on WebGPU
pages.blurb: EmbeddingGemma 2 q4 in the browser, with 2-bit remex codes and the corpus scan in WebGPU kernels on onnxruntime-web's own device

pages.title: EG2 query encoder in hand-written WGSL
pages.blurb: Bench: the 4-layer EmbeddingGemma 2 query encoder run by a custom WebGPU engine against onnxruntime-web (WebGPU and wasm) on the same 25 MB model file

pages.title: EG2 training targets on WebGPU
pages.blurb: Embeds 110,605 query-shaped texts with EmbeddingGemma 2 on the browser's GPU and saves int8 shards, the training targets for a small query encoder distilled into EG2's space

pages.title: Delegation skill map
pages.blurb: 14 agent and delegation skills compared: frontmatter, boundaries, a decision path and cut candidates

pages.title: The Second Sky
pages.blurb: 140 constellations of an invented people, drawn on the real stars by 1,843 Haiku calls

pages.title: Latent Calculator
pages.blurb: A frozen SmolLM2-135M doing arithmetic through a calculator wired between its layers, in the browser

pages.title: Latent Calculator demo
pages.blurb: Explainer page: how the operands are read from layer 16 and the result written back

pages.title: In-browser taxonomy classifier
pages.blurb: gte-small snaps free text onto Wayfair's 860 WANDS product classes, with no server

pages.title: Snooker Break Simulator
pages.blurb: Break simulator: the traditional apex strike against Murphy's third-red break

pages.title: Procedural Lion
pages.blurb: A cartoon lion rebuilt procedurally in three.js, with about 3,000 swept-tube hair strands

pages.title: Geezer Goon
pages.blurb: Animated music video for the Wednesday-ride song, driven by the ride's real Strava data

pages.title: Strudel FM, before and after
pages.blurb: The Strudel FM lead before and after its melody rewrite, with seeded variants

pages.title: A Growth Race for Erdős–Gyárfás
pages.blurb: Research note with partial results on an open problem in graph theory

pages.title: KB Packer
pages.blurb: Build a portable knowledgebase skill in the browser

pages.title: X-ray glasses
pages.blurb: Point the camera at a person, cat or dog: MediaPipe Pose or RTMPose (AP-10K) finds the joints and a WebGPU shader draws a fitted skeleton over a radiograph view of the feed, all on the device

pages.title: GPU Bridge
pages.blurb: Runs WebGPU jobs that Claude Code sessions push to a private GitHub repo on this machine's GPU, commits the results back and wakes the session

pages.title: Voice Loop
pages.blurb: Talk to a small language model running in the page on hand-written WebGPU engines: LFM2.5 350M (phones) or LFM3 1.7B at 4 bits (laptops), the device's dictation in and its voices out, with prefill time and tokens per second on screen

pages.title: DOOM Arena
pages.blurb: The TRM bot plays gPu(doom) on this device's GPU, level after level, restarting a level that stops making progress, and ships a log of every attempt back to the Claude session through the GPU-bridge repo
